name: Elven Hound
specialQualities: resist enchantment (+2 racial bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells or effects)
sprint (once per hour, can move five times its normal speed -- 250 ft. -- when making a charge)
skills: Balance +7, Hide +7, Jump +15, Listen +5, Spot +5, Survival +2*, Swim +6; *+4 racial bonus on Survival checks when tracking by scent
appearance: An oddly large dog, nearly the size of a pony, with a thick greenish coat mottled with large brown spots. Its oversized paws end in long, curved claws suited for traction on soft forest loam, and its ears stand straight up, giving it a keen, attentive look.
behavior: A ferocious and effective fighter with a bone-crushing bite, kept by wood elves (and occasionally high or gray elves) for hunting and guard duty, especially to run down prey already scattered by elven archers. Long-lived for a hound, commonly reaching a century of age.
appearanceGreenbound: The elven hound's greenish coat has become a dense coat of moss and creeping leaves, its brown spots now patches of rough bark-like hide showing through underneath. Its curved claws have hardened into woody thorns, and slender vines trail from its upright ears and haunches, though its pony-sized, alert silhouette remains plainly that of a hunting hound.
note: Also called cooshee. Bite damage die already reflects Improved Natural Attack (bite).

name: Dire Hawk
skills: Listen +8, Move Silently +8, Spot +10 (an extra +8 racial bonus on Spot in daylight)
appearance: A hawk grown to roughly five feet long with an eleven-foot wingspan. A bony ridge crowns the upper beak, and long feathers trail from its underside and tail.
behavior: Strong enough to carry off pigs, sheep, and now and then a small horse. It favors high, remote nesting sites.
appearanceGreenbound: The dire hawk's plumage has become layers of broad, overlapping leaves that hiss with each wingbeat, over a body of pale, springy wood. Its talons are hooked thorns, thin vines stream from the wingtips and tail like living ribbons, and the bony ridge on its beak has turned to a knot of bark.
note: Summoned by Summon Dire Hawk (Races of the Wild p.174, Drd 2), not by summon nature's ally, so it carries no summonNaturesAllyLevel. The creature entry is on p.189 of Races of the Wild, not Kingdoms of Kalamar.
